id: title:haacked:make links in the property info popover clickable

review.posthog_relevance: Adds popover click propagation prevention and link behavior changes, potentially affecting help text interaction and taxonomy link workflow.
review.reason: Adds a new test file and two test cases for PropertyKeyInfo, including a test for overlay persistence and a test for click propagation prevention. P1.F2.H1 adds onClickInside and mouse handlers to the Popover component, including a comment and the implementation of stopPropagation. P1.F3.H1 changes a LazyLink to open in a new tab by adding target="_blank".
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed code, but the actual benefit and impact are not verified. The tier is assigned based on the observed code, but the actual benefit and impact are not verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains three hunks. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 are related: P1.F2.H1 adds the implementation for the behavior described and tested in P1.F1.H1. P1.F3.H1 is unrelated, changing link behavior. No tier assignment is made here; this is an observation-only chunk.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test file and two test cases for PropertyKeyInfo, including a test for overlay persistence and a test for click propagation prevention.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that clicking the popover overlay does not trigger the parent button's onClick, preventing unintended navigation or action when a user interacts with the help text.

observations.behavior: Adds onClickInside and mouse handlers to the Popover component, including a comment and the implementation of stopPropagation.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements the behavior asserted in P1.F1.H1: the popover's internal click does not bubble to the parent wrapper, preserving the wrapper's click behavior.

observations.behavior: Changes a LazyLink to open in a new tab by adding target="_blank".
observations.posthog_connection: Changes taxonomy description links to open in a new tab, potentially affecting user workflow if the link is part of a sequence or if the user does not expect a new tab.
